about: Songs, not clips. Each song has versions (one Suno generation each, oldest first), and each version has two takes (Suno makes two per generation). stage is the song's maturity: idea, experiment, shortlist, pre-release, released. pick is the take chosen to carry the song forward (null until chosen). To make this site your own, fork the repository and replace these songs with your own public Suno songs. A song with "archived" is kept for the record but left out of the home page, the designs and the styles map; its page stays. A take Dinis deleted on Suno is removed from "takes" and listed under the version's "trashed"; each take keeps its letter in "side".
